scenarios.name: Vestigingsgebied landelijk treated as hard exclusion

basis.provenanceNote: NC-BM-01 (art. 5.6) conditions biomass siting in the landelijk designation; this variant executes the strictest reading as a hard exclusion.

scenarios.name: Vestigingsgebied stedelijk treated as hard exclusion

basis.provenanceNote: NC-BM-02 (art. 5.7) conditions biomass siting in the stedelijk designation; this variant executes the strictest reading as a hard exclusion.

scenarios.name: Rural designation exclusion widened by a 500 m band

basis.rationale: No instrument text supports a 500 m siting margin for biomass installations (distance norms are abstained topics); this hypothetical measures what such a margin would carve from the province-wide opportunity zone.
basis.provenanceNote: NOT legally grounded: the designation (NC-BM-01, art. 5.6) is cited, the 500 m margin is the scenario's own parameter.

notes: Phase A deterministic sweep (docs/GENAI_SEAMS.md): no LLM at runtime; scenario specs are schema-validated contracts authored by deterministic-scenario-author#poc-v0.
Deltas are measured against the unmutated control re-executed over the baseline run's cached layers (same tunings), not against summary numbers.
Marker semantics (attention/conditional/compensation) never alter the opportunity zone; set_semantics mutations make that policy choice explicit and visible in the delta.
